title: PyREPL does not recognize OSC sequences
author: edvilme
body_preview: PyREPL’s `ANSI_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE` regex currently recognizes CSI sequences but not Operating System Command (OSC) sequences. As a result, OSC sequences embedded in `sys.ps1`, such as VS Code’s `OSC 633` terminal integration markers, are treated as visible characters and can cause incorrect prompt width calculation and cursor positioning. author: adamtheturtle
